title: Acquire off-the-shelf dog-skin dataset + map to canonical labels + first YOLOv8-cls baseline
description: Pull a real canine skin dataset (Roboflow dog-skin-disease-dataset or a Kaggle set — see docs/ml/data/dataset-scouting.md), map its classes to schema/labels.json (Ringworm->dermatophytosis, bacterial dermatosis->bacterial_pyoderma, Healthy->OOD, Demodicosis->drop, etc.), and train a first yolov8-cls baseline on a held-out split. Fast/dirty baseline to prove the pipeline end-to-end; credible eval still requires the vet gold set (ll2). Needs Kaggle/Roboflow access.
notes: DATA IN HAND: yashmotiani/dogs-skin-disease-dataset (Kaggle, CC0-1.0, 439 imgs, downloaded to scratchpad, already in class-folder layout for yolov8-cls). Classes: Fungal_infections 137, Healthy 119, Bacterial_dermatosis 94, Hypersensitivity_allergic 89. GAP: only 3 disease classes vs our 5 canonical — dataset lumps dermatophytosis+malassezia (Fungal) and atopic+contact (Hypersensitivity); Healthy=OOD. Cat data exists separately (adityavahreza/cat-skin-disease-v2, 60MB). Decision pending: coarse baseline vs combine datasets vs defer. Needs ultralytics+torch install to train.

title: Decide model task: classifier vs detector (1-page)
description: Recommend classifier unless lesion localization is needed. Include decision criteria (need boxes? labeling budget? is top-k enough?). Fix mock model.name so it stops claiming yolov8.
notes: REVISED to v0.2: use YOLOv8 classification mode (yolov8-cls), not a generic classifier. Keeps the YOLOv8 branding truthful (no frontend churn), still image-level labels, contract unchanged. See docs/ml/model-task-decision.md.
close_reason: Decided: image classifier (petcare-derm-classifier), not detection. Recorded in docs/ml/model-task-decision.md with criteria table and revisit triggers. No contract schema change needed.

title: Stand up contract-conformant mock inference service
description: Single FastAPI file or static JSON dev server returning contract-valid responses. Agree wiring so PetCare-Web new-analysis flow consumes it via env URL, retiring Math.random() and hardcoded 87%.
notes: Built services/triage-mock/ (FastAPI). Deterministic scenario selector (mockScenario form field / X-Mock-Scenario header) drives all resultStates + error codes — no randomness. Urgency computed from urgency-policy.json; every 200 body validated against triage-response.schema.json before return. Verified: smoke_test.py (10 scenarios + 3 validation paths) and live curl over uvicorn (completed=follow_up, completed_urgent=consult_soon, OOD null prediction, timeout 504, gif 400). Model name petcare-derm-classifier.
close_reason: Standalone contract-conformant mock built and verified end-to-end over HTTP; frontend wiring deferred to sign-off (r8h).

title: Make inference contract executable (JSON Schema + labels + urgency policy)
description: Convert docs/ml/inference-contract.md prose output into a versioned JSON Schema/OpenAPI (contract v0.1), plus labels.json and an urgency-policy table. Freeze and send to frontend owners for sign-off. Prose contracts drift across mock/service/UI.
design: Errors (non-200) separated from outcomes (200 low_confidence/OOD). Canonical label ids authoritative; display strings match src/lib/mock-data.ts. Urgency = ordered rule table, never raw confidence. labels/urgency versioned independently of API version.
notes: Delivered docs/ml/schema/: openapi.yaml (v0.1.0), triage-response.schema.json, triage-error.schema.json, labels.json, urgency-policy.json, README.md. Bumped inference-contract.md to v0.1. Added explicit resultState field so UI branches on one field instead of deriving from confidence. Validated: contract example passes; schema rejects bogus condition/confidence>1/extra fields; OOD null-prediction accepted.
close_reason: Executable contract v0.1 delivered and validated; frontend sign-off tracked separately.

title: Get frontend owners to sign off on contract v0.1
description: Send docs/ml/schema/ to PetCare-Web owners; confirm endpoint shape, HTTP<->error mapping, CORS, auth-token passing, 5MB limit, and the resultState addition before freezing v0.1 and creating petcare-triage-service.

title: Build vet-verified gold evaluation set
description: Source candidates (HF Hub first), write labeling guide (5 conditions + unknown + quality/OOD flags), get small vet-verified test set, version on HF datasets. Never train on it.
notes: DESK WORK DONE: docs/ml/data/ — dataset-scouting.md (HF survey: no pet-derm image dataset exists; reuse Hub only for OOD negatives + human-derm pretraining; verdict = build a vet-verified set), labeling-guide.md (vet-confirmed protocol, cues, adjudication, quality flags matching the contract), gold-eval-set.md (composition ~400 imgs, provenance manifest schema, sourcing sequence, freeze/leakage discipline, acceptance). REMAINING (real-world, gated on humans): secure vet-clinic partnership, collect+label images, version manifest on HF. Blocks oej.

title: Train baseline calibrated classifier + offline eval harness
description: Transfer-learn a pretrained backbone; run offline eval on gold set: per-class recall, confusion matrix, ECE, OOD AUROC. Replaces mock behind the same contract.

title: Evaluate ML/backend architecture with Claude Opus
description: Use Claude Opus as a second reviewer for the PetCare ML Lead architecture decision. Compare options for keeping ML/backend separate from the frontend, sequencing requirements/data/contract work, and identifying risks before creating a new service repo.

value: LLM provider preference: use DeepSeek (user has an API key) for any LLM-based feature in PetCare (e.g. generating preventive recommendations text, understanding symptomNotes, or a vet chatbot). The core dermatology triage is vision-only via YOLOv8-cls and does NOT need an LLM. Model decision recorded in docs/ml/model-task-decision.md (YOLOv8 classification mode).
